tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bdud rtsi lnga mchod bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab bskyil ba// lpu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi// ar+ghaṃ mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de wī ye/ ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni// rna ba dang ni de bzhin sna// lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan// dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// o shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ pañtsa in+d+ra gu h+ya puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen po// bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan// byin za chen por bsregs pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā me da gu h+ya dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrang chen po// sra ba'i ras kyi sdong bur bcas// yi dwags me yis sbar ba yi// snang gsal mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā ma dhu ra gu h+ya ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi khrag dang zhag /bdud rtsi lnga yis yang dag sbags// nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pa// rab tu sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/

ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā ba sa ru dhi ra gu h+ya gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi// bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan// ri rab rgya mtshor mnyam pa yi// ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta/ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dam tshig skul ba'i sgra// rnga chen kun nas brjid pa'i sgra// dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra// cang te'u phrin las skul ba'i sgra// gsang ba'i rde'u chung dbang sdud sgra// sna tshogs rol mo mchod pa'i sgra// 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i// zab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye shap+da pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam mkha'i rgyan// rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan// keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan// phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan// 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ gu h+ya ā laṃ kri ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa// lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan// bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar te// ye shes lnga yis byin rlabs pa// kha dog dri ro nus par ldan// dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas// mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi// gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// dpal ldan ma hā kā la dang*// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/

ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ gu h+ya a mṛ ta sa mu dra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas// sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis// bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni// mngon par byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// dam tshig bzhin du bdag 'bul gyis// thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la// dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs nas// rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi// las rnams thams cad grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de wī ye/ ma hā pañtsa maṃ sa/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba lin+ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rgyal po rab khros pa'i// khro bo'i khro bo mnyes byed pa// gsang ba'i mchod gtor rim pa 'di// rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas sbyar/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
